title: COUNTROWS ( ALL ( table ) ) counts the blank row

source.quote: ALL considers the blank row as valid
source.supports: ALL treats the blank row as a valid row

source.quote: ALL includes in the result the additional blank row generated for invalid relationships

derivation: Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so the relationship is invalid and Product gets a blank row. ALL ( Product ) returns the 3 stored rows and the blank row: 4.
